## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): e side n = +3.2×10¹², h side n = −1.2×10¹²

Raw R(B) first (top row), then vs 1/B, then the FFT. **Read:** the device is in the quantum-Hall regime by ~2 T on both sides — Rxx oscillates from ~1.5 T and its minima reach ≈ 0 Ω (run 6 at 1.9, 2.4, 3.6, 6.0, 7.2 T; run 7 at 1.7, 3.4 T), so the fan is viable at this T_e and 10 T. Drain current sags < 1.5 % (9.84–9.94 nA); no leakage (gate currents at their pA offsets, the ±100 pA excursions are the 2400 offset behaviour seen since gate C). Noise floor 4–7 Ω pt-to-pt at 50 µV. **Tone content is not the naive one:** the strongest 1/B-periodic component sits at **7.1–7.4 T on *both* sides** despite the 2.7× density difference (naive 4-fold full-density F_L = 33.1 / 12.4 T), with harmonics; n-dependent content is also present (e side ≈ 27–30 T ≈ 0.8–0.9 F_L; h side 12.6 T ≈ F_L). Two readings, not separable from two 1D cuts: (a) a light band whose occupancy barely moves with gate (an ABAB-type two-band picture — the light-band model frequency was 7.5 T at +3.2×10¹² and 7.1 T at −1.2×10¹²), or (b) a region not gated with the channel (contact-adjacent, Si-coupled, or region B). The 8–10 T hump in run 6 (R 300→530 Ω, ν ≈ 13–16) and the rise to 590 Ω at 10 T in run 7 (ν ≈ 5) are broad, not a single gap. **Not a stacking read yet** — the fan (n × B at D = 0) separates (a) from (b) directly: gated bands fan out of the CNP, an ungated region shows as n-independent horizontal stripes.

"""Runs 6 + 7 — sdh-spot-check at D = 0 (e side n = +3.2e12, h side n = -1.2e12; run-5 calibration).
Raw R(B) first, then R vs 1/B with the naive 4-fold LL fillings at the nominal n, then the SdH FFT + onset tracker."""
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(13, 11))
for j, (rid, n12) in enumerate([(6, 3.2), (7, -1.2)]):
    r = run(rid)
    ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I; T = r.col("T_sample")
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R, I, T = B[o], R[o], I[o], T[o]
    FL = luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16)
    m = (B > 0.3) & (B < 1.0); noise = np.std(np.diff(R[m])) / np.sqrt(2)
    print(f"=== run {rid}: n = {n12:+.2f}e12 (F_L 4-fold = {FL:.1f} T; nu(10 T) = {abs(n12)*1e16*cst.h/(10*cst.e):.1f}); "
          f"T {T.min():.3f}-{T.max():.3f} K; I_drain {I.min()*1e9:.2f}-{I.max()*1e9:.2f} nA; R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm; "
          f"pt-pt noise (0.3-1 T) {noise:.1f} Ohm; interrupted={r.interrupted}")
    ax[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.8); ax[0, j].set_title(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0 — raw Rxx (B_1-B_2)")
    ax[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, j].set_ylabel("R (Ohm)")
    mm = B > 1.0
    ax[1, j].plot(1 / B[mm], R[mm], lw=0.8); ax[1, j].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[1, j].set_ylabel("R (Ohm)")
    for nu in range(4, 100, 4):
        b = abs(n12) * 1e16 * cst.h / (nu * cst.e)
        if 1.0 < b < 10: ax[1, j].axvline(1 / b, color="0.8", lw=0.5)
    ax[1, j].set_title("vs 1/B; grey = nu = 4k at the nominal n (naive 4-fold, full density)")
    for b_lo in (1.5, 2.5):
        freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(b_lo, 10.0), nfft=2048, bg_degree=3, log=False)
        sp = spec[0]; fm = (freqs > 2) & (freqs < 120)
        pk = np.sort(freqs[fm][np.argsort(sp[fm])[::-1][:6]])
        print(f"  FFT {b_lo}-10 T (poly-3 bg, linear R): strongest peaks {np.round(pk, 1)} T")
        ax[2, j].plot(freqs, sp / sp[fm].max(), label=f"window {b_lo}-10 T")
    ax[2, j].axvline(FL, color="r", ls="--", label=f"F_L 4-fold {FL:.1f} T"); ax[2, j].axvline(FL / 2, color="r", ls=":", label="F_L/2 (8-fold)")
    ax[2, j].set_xlim(0, 80); ax[2, j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[2, j].legend(fontsize=7); ax[2, j].set_title("SdH FFT in 1/B")
    try:
        so = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=1.0, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9, bg_degree=3); print(so.summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print("  onset:", e)
fig.suptitle("vti-02 runs 6-7: sdh-spot-check at D = 0, T = 1.17-1.29 K, sr1 50 uV"); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), n −1.25 … +3.25×10¹² × B 0.4 → 10 T

> **05:26** · landau-fan D=0: n -1.25..+3.25e12 (131 pts, Vtg -0.291..+0.998, Vbg -0.484..+1.185 co-swept) fast x B 0.4->10 T 0.2 T (49 rows) slow; Vsi 0; sr1 100 uV; fast\_delay 1 s; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~09:01** (≈3h35m)

Plan step 4 (`hera_scratch/plan.md`), the operator's requested next move. Runs 6–7 (ana) put the device in the QH regime from ~2 T with Rxx minima at ≈ 0 Ω, but the two 1D cuts share a dominant **7.1–7.4 T tone that does not scale with n** (2.7× density change) alongside n-dependent content — a two-band (ABAB-type light band) reading and an ungated-region reading are indistinguishable in 1D. The fan separates them: gated bands fan out of the CNP, an ungated region is a horizontal stripe. It also (i) fixes the **absolute density scale** from the LL slopes ν = nh/eB (c_tg is still the 9.5 nm prior), (ii) reads the degeneracy sequence out of the CNP (±4 vs ±8), (iii) shows crossings (two bands) vs a single fan, (iv) e/h asymmetry. **Design:** fast axis = (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept along the run-5-calibrated D = 0 line, n = −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² in 131 pts (Δn 0.035×10¹² ≈ 9.9 mV TG; ≥ 5.6 pts per 4-fold gap above 2 T, 28 at 10 T); slow = B 0.4 → 10 T in 0.2 T, 49 rows, uniform in B so LL lines are straight. **Coverage trade:** the hole side stops at −1.25×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit) vs +3.25 on the electron side — the D = 0 line is TG-limited at both ends, nothing more is reachable without leaving D = 0; the B range starts at 0.4 T (below ~1.5 T there are no oscillations at this T_e). Si held at 0 V. sr1 fixed at 100 µV (10 kΩ FS — run 5 read 50 Ω features at this range; the ν = 0 state at high B may exceed it → flat top at the CNP only, accepted as a "> 10 kΩ" read). Dwell fast_delay 1 s / slow_delay 3 s as run 5 (lag ≲ 1 step, uniform per row); the magnet's 3 s settle per row is inside the blocking set. Guards: interrupt on |I_gate| > 1 nA or T_sample > 2 K. **Price** (run 5: 1.10 s/pt; run 6: 0.134 T/min): 49 × 131 × 1.10 s = 118 min + 10 T ramp 75 min + row overhead ~8 min ≈ 3h20m; realistic ≈ 3h35m. Ends at **10 T** with the gates at the fan's end point; step 5 rides the magnet down. **Checkpoints:** first row (~4 min: signal level, rail at the CNP?, gate currents, B readback tracking); then at rows ~10 (2.2 T), ~25 (5.2 T), ~40 (8.2 T) re-form the partial fan — continue if LL lines fan from a common CNP; stop and rethink if the map is featureless or dominated by n-independent stripes.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): n fast along the calibrated D = 0 line x B slow 0.4 -> 10 T (plan step 4) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.25, 131)            # 1e12 cm^-2, dn = 0.035e12 (~10 mV TG); TG-limited both ends
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, 0.0, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = np.asarray(Vtg_vec), np.asarray(Vbg_vec)
MARGIN = 0.002
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN + MARGIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX - MARGIN, (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max())
assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN + MARGIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX - MARGIN, (Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
_nchk, _Dchk = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.abs(np.asarray(_Dchk)).max() < 1e-6
print(f"fast axis: {len(n_vec)} pts, n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12 at D = 0; "
      f"Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V ({(Vtg_vec[1]-Vtg_vec[0])*1e3:.1f} mV), Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V")

# --- field rows: uniform in B (LL lines are straight in (n, B)); blocking magnet, start where it sits (0 T) ---
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.4, 10.0001, 0.2), 3)   # 49 rows
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0                    # run-5 pacing: 1.10 s/pt measured; lag <~ 1 step, uniform per row
I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 2.0                           # A, K — guards (no operator eyes in E1)

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff left it at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA (run-5 map read 50 Ohm features at this range;
# the nu = 0 state at high B may exceed it -> flat top at the CNP only, accepted).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS), sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; "
      f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> {sr1.amplitude()/100e6*1e9:.1f} nA; magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")
print(f"price: {len(B_vec)} rows x {len(n_vec)} pts x 1.10 s + 10 T / 0.134 T/min + {len(B_vec)} x ~10 s -> "
      f"~{(len(B_vec)*len(n_vec)*1.10 + 10/0.134*60 + len(B_vec)*10)/3600:.2f} h")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D = 0: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts, run-5 cal) fast x B {B_vec[0]}..{B_vec[-1]} T "
                  f"({len(B_vec)} rows, 0.2 T) slow; sr1 100 uV; fast_delay 1 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 line (run-5 cal: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e} F/m2 prior-anchored, '
              f'n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm); fast (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept: '
              f'n = {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12, {len(n_vec)} pts (dn {n_vec[1]-n_vec[0]:.4f}e12); '
              f'slow B = {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, {len(B_vec)} rows (0.2 T); Vsi = 0; T ~ 1.2 K; sr1 sens 100 uV')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    t_s, i_tg, i_bg = float(data[4]), abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if t_s > T_TRIP:
        print(f"T TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: T_sample = {t_s:.3f} K > {T_TRIP} K")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
# field stays at 10 T (the next step rides it down); gates left where the sweep ends — readback:
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
